scenario: Retarget a loaded CommonJS package symlink under app/node_modules while --hmr is resident.

entry_symlink.description: The CLI entry itself is a symlink; retarget it from targets/one.cjs to targets/two.cjs while --hmr is resident.
entry_symlink.result: The entry alias change restarted the resident CLI with the same PID and executed the new target.

esm_package_symlink.description: A .mjs entry imports the ESM bare package `pkg`; retarget app/node_modules/pkg from workspace/pkg-a to workspace/pkg-b while --hmr is resident.
esm_package_symlink.result: The package link change restarted the resident CLI with the same PID and loaded the new ESM package target.

relative_commonjs_symlink.description: A CommonJS entry requires ./linked/value.cjs through an app/linked directory symlink; retarget linked from workspace/lib-a to workspace/lib-b.
relative_commonjs_symlink.result: The relative resolution link change restarted the resident CLI with the same PID and required the new target.

worker_relative_symlink.description: A file-backed worker requires ./linked/value.cjs through an app/linked directory symlink; retarget linked from workspace/lib-a to workspace/lib-b.
worker_relative_symlink.result: The worker-published link stamp reached the parent watcher, which restarted the CLI with the same PID and started one new worker using the new target.
worker_relative_symlink.control: Before retargeting, the resident session emitted one worker message over five seconds; the parent did not enter a restart loop.

result: CommonJS and ESM bare package links, relative CommonJS links, worker-loaded relative links, and the CLI entry link were detected; the resident CLI restarted with the same PID and loaded the newly resolved source.
implementation: HMR records symlinks used by file and package resolution as restart-only graph inputs. Worker graphs publish symlink paths with their own path identity; the parent preserves these aliases while importing stamps. Link stamps hash the link target itself rather than following it to the unchanged source file.
